response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.state_county_province AS st, COUNT(DISTINCT cu.customer_id) AS cnt FROM Customers cu JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = cu.customer_id GROUP BY cu.state_county_province), s AS (SELECT st, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), t AS (SELECT st, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_avg FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM t WHERE share > overall_avg
